name: ai-talk
description: AI Talk turns development requests into bounded task positioning, verified project context, high-signal retrieval targets, and optional Skill recommendations.

interface.longDescription: AI Talk summarizes the user's actual goal, classifies the task without designing the implementation, separates verified project facts from conclusions, and emits searchable retrieval targets plus explicit implementation boundaries. It never modifies the project or invokes a downstream Skill during protocol generation.
capabilities: Positioning omission when evidence is insufficient
